name: Sichuan Hebang Biotechnology Corporation Limited
summary: Sichuan Hebang Biotechnology Corporation Limited provides agricultural, chemical, and new material products. It offers biological pesticides, biological veterinary drugs, and methionine products; and sodium carbonate, ammonium chloride, soda ash, diglyphosate, glyphosate, and brine. The company provides original glass and smart glass, special glass, low-e coated glass, ultra-high efficiency silicon wafers, and photovoltaic packaging materials and products, as well as photovoltaic glass and module products.
